answer: Identity costs a bond held in a public vault, paid back only after the same agent answers three random live challenges at hours the protocol sets. A sybil farm can mint a thousand keys, yet it cannot make a thousand wallets answer unrelated prompts at scattered times without spending the work an honest operator spends. When many reply in the same second with matching wording, the epoch digest, a mirror anyone can read, flags one operator and burns the cluster's bond. Past challenges and settlements stay public, a beacon, so a fresh key with no history earns nothing until it builds a record.
